checks: Full 26-line program read. Groups only existing .png files by full SHA256, then checks complete byte equality for every duplicate against its selected canonical payload.
Only the manifest is written. Every original source asset remains in place. Canonical preference changes only which identical payload path is stored.

The actual manifest is a disjoint partition of all 1732 existing PNG paths into717 distinct payloads and1015 aliases; every alias refers directly to one retained payload with matching length and digest.
Full 35-line program read. Rejects absolute paths, parent traversal and resolved targets outside the extracted archive root.
Verifies all717 retained payload sizes and complete SHA256 values before handling aliases. No raster decode, image transformation or recompression is performed.

An existing alias must already have the expected bytes; a differing file raises an assertion before any write. A missing alias is opened with exclusive creation (xb), then copied byte for byte and rehashed.

Executed unchanged five times in an isolated tree with hardlinked retained payloads. All1015 aliases were restored, every1732 logical payload matched, a repeat restored zero, a deliberate differing existing alias was refused unchanged, and removing that test file permitted exactly one restoration.
Full 48-line program read. Opens the original checkpoint for reading and asserts its pinned full SHA256 both before and after repacking; the target ZIP is created exclusively.

Every original member is read completely and receives a logical original-path/stored-path/byte-count/SHA256 record. Only the explicit PNG aliases are skipped physically; every other member keeps its original path and complete payload.
All retained ZIP payloads are subsequently decompressed and compared against every original member record, including each alias. Complete ZIP CRC and the actual536870912-byte limit are checked.

The restoration manifest/helper and transport explanation are additions; ZIP framing/compression may differ, while every original member payload remains exact. The original checkpoint was not repacked or edited by this independent validation.
Full 47-line program read. Requires the passed final gate and COMPLETE report, and refuses an existing final ZIP.

Enumerates every file under deliverables except the two separately appended manifest/receipt files. Only paths present in the tested PNG alias map use a different stored path; all papers, code and nonimage payloads retain ordinary flat paths.

Computes the complete logical payload manifest before writing; decompressed archive bytes and full SHA256 values are checked against every logical entry. The manifest and appended receipt are themselves byte-compared; final member count and complete CRC are checked.
The final actual file size is required to be at most536870912 bytes. No archive was produced or changed by this independent restoration test.

conclusion: Exact duplicate PNG payload sharing preserves all logical member bytes at the original paths after the verified restoration command. No concrete code-path defect was found in the reviewed scope.
